nodes.text:
China is battling yet another outbreak of a respiratory disease called Human metapneumovirus (HMPV). HMPV was first isolated in the Netherlands in 2001.
From videos circulating on the internet, the hospitals in China looks overwhelmed as they respond to the surging numbers.
